```{r}

library(hexSticker)
library(magick)

img <- image_read("/Users/eylul/Desktop/JSD-Methylation/great/GREAT-Analysis/inst/figures/formula.png")
img_transparent <- image_transparent(img, "white")  
image_write(img_transparent, path = "inst/figures/formula_transparent.png", format = "png")


imgurl <- "/Users/eylul/Desktop/JSD-Methylation/great/GREAT-Analysis/inst/figures/formula_transparent.png"


sticker(imgurl,
        package = "shannonR",
        p_color = "#2c3e50",    
        p_size = 20,
        #p_y = 1.5,               
        s_x = 1,
        s_y = 0.8,
        s_width = 0.6,
        h_fill = "#ecf0f1",     
        h_color = "#2c3e50", 
        filename = "inst/figures/shannonR_sticker.png")



```
